meta.model: Ridge(alpha=100) on 7 locked bottom-up features + intercept
meta.sigma_method: sqrt(mean(val residuals^2)), train-fit model on 2022-2023 (Stern starting value 13.0 recalibrated)
meta.prediction_time: Tuesday morning of game week; weeks < W only
meta.market_note: Closing line is the benchmark only — never a model input. No market column exists in features_v3.parquet.
meta.tuesday_qb_rule: Starter = last game's actual starter (injury report never designates a QB Out/Doubtful before Tuesday 8am ET; verified 0/373 rows 2015-2024).
